name: open-compute v0.4 Self-Hosted Workers Platform
description: Self-hosted Workers platform with KV, D1, R2, Durable Objects and Queues.

upstream.license: Apache-2.0 (bundled workerd fork: Cloudflare workerd licence)

PORT.description: Port of the in-container proxy (public domain and healthcheck). ocd itself listens on 127.0.0.1:8787.

OPEN_COMPUTE_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Global admin token: Dashboard sign-in, instance control, metrics. Generated at deploy; changing it rotates it on the next start.

OPEN_COMPUTE_DEPLOYER_TOKEN.description: Deploy token for cf and CI (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN). Can deploy and manage Workers and resources, not the instance.

OPEN_COMPUTE_READ_ONLY_TOKEN.description: Read-only API token for monitoring and audits. Must differ from the other two tokens.

OC_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public origin of the Dashboard and API (used for Live Tail and Git remote URLs). Set your custom domain here if you add one.

OC_API_BASE_URL.description: Copy into CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE_URL on your laptop or in CI. Informational; not read by the service.

OC_PRIVATE_URL.description: Base URL for other services in this project: API at /client/v4, Workers at /w/{worker}/. Informational.

OC_PATH_ROUTES.description: true serves each Worker at {OC_PUBLIC_URL}/w/{worker-name}/ (prefix stripped, X-Forwarded-Prefix set). false turns it off.

OC_WORKERS_DOMAIN.description: Optional wildcard base, e.g. workers.example.com: {worker}.workers.example.com serves that Worker. Add *.workers.example.com as a custom domain.

OC_HOST_ROUTES.description: Optional exact domains: app.example.com=my-worker,api.example.com=api. Add each domain as a custom domain on this service.

OC_DASHBOARD.description: Serve the operator Dashboard at /operator/ (sign in with the admin token). false disables it.

OC_STORAGE_BACKEND.description: Object bytes: local = on the volume (default). s3 = the Railway Bucket (experimental). Fixed after the first successful start.

OC_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint for OC_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3 (the template's Railway Bucket). Unused in local mode.

OC_S3_REGION.description: Bucket region for request signing (auto on Railway).

OC_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket access key. Passed to ocd only when OC_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3.

OC_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Bucket secret key. Passed to ocd only when OC_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3.

OC_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: false = virtual-hosted requests (current Railway Buckets); true = path style (older buckets, see the Bucket's Credentials tab).

OC_S3_PREFIX.description: Bucket prefix for platform objects (bundles, assets, snapshots). Disjoint from OC_S3_R2_PREFIX.

OC_S3_R2_PREFIX.description: Bucket prefix for the R2 buckets your Workers create.

OC_EXTRA_CONFIG.description: Advanced: extra compute.toml sections (e.g. [ai] backends for AI Search). Must not repeat sections the template renders.

OC_CPU_LIMIT.description: Cores ocd sizes its runtime threads for. auto = the container's CPU quota (else nproc), capped at 8; or a number.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period on redeploy so ocd can drain requests and stop workerd cleanly (upstream uses 60 s).
